nodes.label: while vs do...while vs for Loops
nodes.norm_label: while vs do...while vs for loops
nodes.rationale: while checks before each round and may run 0 times (most two-pointer problems); do...while runs at least once; for when start/end/step are known.

nodes.label: Digit Manipulation (Numbers Without Strings)
nodes.rationale: Use % 10 and / 10 to process digits; O(log10 n) time, one step per digit.

nodes.label: Half-Reverse Palindrome Number Trick
nodes.rationale: Stop when reversed >= number, then compare number == reversed || number == reversed / 10 (the /10 drops the middle digit for odd digit counts). Reversing only half avoids int overflow.

nodes.label: Nested Loops Are Not Always O(n^2)
nodes.norm_label: nested loops are not always o(n^2)
nodes.rationale: Count total pointer moves; inner loops that never restart keep the whole thing O(n).

nodes.label: How to Start Any Problem
nodes.rationale: Write own examples including edge cases, classify input type, match against known patterns, write simplest working solution first then optimize Time/Space, then run tests and edge-case checklist.

nodes.label: Two Pointers (Opposite Ends)
nodes.rationale: Used for comparing/swapping from both ends (palindromes, reversing, pair sums on sorted array). O(n) time, O(1) space. Prefer while over do...while so empty and single-char inputs skip the loop without special cases; return early on mismatch.

nodes.label: Two Pointers + Skip
nodes.rationale: Same as two pointers but some characters don't count. Still O(n) because inner skip loops never restart; inner loops must also check left < right to avoid crossing on all-junk strings. Avoid building a clean copy, which costs O(n) space.
